item.name: Add an employee to a group

header.description: Unique key to ensure idempotent requests. If the same key is used for multiple _identical & successful_ requests, the same response will be returned. [Read more here](/api#idempotent-requests)

request.description: Adds an existing employee to a `group`. The employee must belong to the same employer as the `group`. If there is a `group_policy` associated with the `group`, a corresponding `enrolment_intent` will be created for the employee.

item.name: Check employee eligibility for a group

request.description: Checks whether an `employee` qualifies for a `group` without adding them to it. This is a dry-run eligibility check — the employee is not enrolled or added. The response includes provider and plan information.
Updates the specified `group`. Only `name` and `description` can be updated. Any parameters not provided will be left unchanged.

query.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `pending`, `ready`, `archived`.
The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
